description.value: Harbour Spoon is an Eastern European restaurant tucked into the Harbour Centre food court in downtown Vancouver, serving hand-made comfort food including borscht, pierogies, cabbage rolls, Siberian pelmeni, and traditional pastries alongside house-made fermented beverages like kvass and cranberry mors. The kitchen prides itself on using locally sourced ingredients with no preservatives, MSG, GMO, or nuts. It's a rare find for cyclists wanting an affordable, filling, made-from-scratch meal in the heart of the city.

address.value: 555 West Hastings Street, FC-12, Vancouver, BC V6B 4N6

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (9 spaces) at 44m; stands (2 spaces) at 52m; stands (4 spaces) at 57m; stands (2 spaces) at 61m; stands (4 spaces) at 74m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m; rack (2 spaces) at 81m. Total: 25 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and located in the Harbour Centre food court (FC12, level -1) at 555 West Hastings Street, Vancouver. Phone number 778-953-2253 and address match OSM exactly. The website explicitly lists vegan, gluten-free, and vegetarian options, and confirms dine-in and takeout service; no bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere in the site content.
concerns: Restaurant is located at level -1 (basement food court) inside Harbour Centre mall; bike access and parking directly at the entrance may be limited.

OSM cuisine tag is 'russian' but the business now brands itself as Eastern European and previously operated as 'Russian Spoon' (captured in old_name tag); minor branding mismatch, not a data-quality issue.

OSM opening_hours (Mo-Sa 10:00-18:00) differ from the website's stated hours (Mon-Fri 11:00am-5:45pm, Sat-Sun-Holidays closed); website shows Saturday as closed, OSM shows it open. Website hours are likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Vancouver with a confirmed website and matching contact details; a good option for touring cyclists wanting an affordable, hearty Eastern European meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists 'Vegan Options' and 'Gluten Free Options' under Our Values; multiple menu items are explicitly labeled Vegan (Borscht, Mushroom soup) or Gluten Free (Borscht, Cabbage Rolls); a dedicated 'Vegetarian meal combo' is offered
